notes.title: a pet shop after dark is out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412579/6fd3264c661ca54c023037ae42bf13eee042b8a7.gif

My new game a pet shop after dark is out now. It's a horror point-and-click adventure! There's a 10% launch sale.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934800/a_pet_shop_after_dark/

Come work for a strange pet shop and be remunerated very handsomely so long as you don't stick your nose too far into places where it doesn't belong...

Awaiting you at the pet shop are...

 Little plants thirsty for water
 Hungry pets you cannot see
 Puzzles to enjoy in a safe working environment
We can't wait for you to join us... 🔍
